diego (Eng Manager): Hi team — need help. Candidate on team is being promoted from L2 -> L3 at offer acceptance. We want to make promo effective on first day and apply sign-on + small equity top-up. What approvals and docs are required to bundle promo with offer?

mina (People Ops): Congrats! Two paths: 1) Promo as part of new-hire offer (handled by Recruiting + Comp) or 2) internal promo effective day 1 for internal transfer/new role. Which is it?

diego (Eng Manager): It's internal candidate moving teams (still employed), accepted internal offer. We want comp change start date = first day in new team (two weeks from now). Also request equity refresh (25 RSUs) to align to L3 target.

ana (Compensation): Ana here. For internal promotions that hit new grant, we need: - manager note + role scope, - documented calibration outcome (brief), - comp band recommendation, - equity rationale (size & vesting). Equity grants require Finance + Equity team OK. If effective date is within 30 days, payroll treat as adjustment; if not, backpay approval needed.

harry (Finance): If equity is additional grant, we need valuation approval and budget code. Send budget owner and the chargeback tag. For cash backpay >$5k, we also need Finance director sign-off.

mina (People Ops): Also note: managers should not post salary numbers in public Slack. Use the secure leveling upload sheet and the equity request form. payroll-bot enforces.

payroll-bot: Heads up: do not include SSNs or bank info in channel. Use https://redwood/payroll/secure and https://redwood/equity/request for grants.

 diego (Eng Manager): OK — what's the quickest approval path? We need this before the new payroll cut (10 business days).

ana (Compensation): Fast path: Manager uploads justification + calibration note and comp target to leveling portal, flags "expedite". Comp will triage within 48 hours. Finance and Equity can fast-track but need explicit budget code and sponsor. If any exception (equity > standard refresh, or >15% salary change), we'll route to director-level review.

mina (People Ops): Checklist for you to upload now: 1) internal offer acceptance screenshot (no PII), 2) manager justification (bullet list), 3) comp target number + percentile, 4) equity ask with vesting schedule, 5) budget code & sponsor, 6) requested effective date, 7) expedite flag.

 diego (Eng Manager): Manager justification example please?

ana (Compensation): Short example: "Expanded ownership: now owning payments infra and 2 services; shipped checkout latency reduction; mentoring team leads. Recommended L3 at 55th percentile to reflect market and retention risk." Keep it 2	6 bullets.

mina (People Ops): Note on payroll handling: if effective date = first day of role and <30 days retro, payroll will do a recurring salary adjustment effective that pay period. If equity grant needs to be included in payroll withholding, tell payroll whether to withhold at grant or on vest.

harry (Finance): For the equity value: provide grant date fair value and P&L bucket. We'll respond with budget ok/no-ok within 2 business days if files are correct.

diego (Eng Manager): What about probation or promo clock resets? This is still internal; does promo cadence reset?

mina (People Ops): For internal moves with level increase, promo cadence resets to the new level's clock. Performance review cadence aligns to new role after effective date. We record in HRIS.

 diego (Eng Manager): If compensation difference is paid as lump sum sign-on vs ongoing bump, pros/cons?

ana (Compensation): Lump-sum sign-on addresses immediate retention and avoids long-term comp inflation; ongoing bump adjusts base and affects future equity and org comp metrics. Tell us your preference and reason. We can model total comp scenarios.

mina (People Ops): I'll draft an expedited routing flow to attach to your submission so reviewers know timeline expectations and approvers (Comp -> Finance -> Equity -> Payroll).

payroll-bot: Reminder: use secure forms for uploads. Any payroll ticket should include employee ID only in secure system, not here.

 diego (Eng Manager): Uploaded justification and budget code to the leveling portal and flagged expedite. Pinged @ana and @harry.

ana (Compensation): Got it. Triage started. Expect initial reply within 48 hours. If we approve, I'll add instructions to Finance for grant valuation.

harry (Finance): Received. I'll review budget and reply by EOD tomorrow. If any documents missing I'll tag here.

mina (People Ops): Final live checklist for thread close: upload to portal, flag expedite, provide budget/sponsor, choose lump vs bump, confirm equity vesting, Comp triages (48h), Finance approves (2bd), Equity issues grant, Payroll executes on effective date. I'll leave the thread open until payroll confirms post-change.
